Peptide-length window of an MHC class

Source: R/report-helpers.R
mhc_length_window.Rd

Single source of truth for the "selected peptides" (pep_short) length window used by every report template and by the quality-score engine.

Usage

mhc_length_window(mhcclass = "MHC1", min = NULL, max = NULL)

Arguments

mhcclass

One of "MHC1" (default), "MHC1_mouse", "MHC2", or any other string to use the custom min/max window.

min, max

Custom window bounds, used only when mhcclass is not one of the built-in classes.

Value

An integer vector c(lo, hi).

Details

The built-in classes are the canonical ligand-length windows: "MHC1" 8-13 AAs (human HLA-I), "MHC1_mouse" 7-11 AAs (murine H-2, whose ligands run shorter — H-2Kb favours 8-mers), and "MHC2" 12-25 AAs. Any other value falls back to the explicit min/max arguments, which is how the ShortPeptideLengthMin/ShortPeptideLengthMax report params take over for a custom window.

Examples

mhc_length_window("MHC1")
#> [1]  8 13
mhc_length_window("MHC1_mouse")
#> [1]  7 11
mhc_length_window("custom", min = 9, max = 11)
#> [1]  9 11
